title: [review] provisioning.py:403: Exception sanitization in
description: process_message_1 lets EDHOC exceptions propagate directly, unlike process_message_3 which catches and re-raises as AuthenticationFailedError with generic message. Line 426 comments explicitly note 'Do not reveal exception details - could enable oracle attacks' but this protection is not applied here. Malformed msg1 inputs could leak internal EDHOC state through exception details.
